name: input
usage_doc_md:
Input is a styled text field. Use with v-model for two-way binding. Pair with Label and form messages.

```vue
<Input v-model="email" type="email" placeholder="you@company.com" />
```

name: textarea
usage_doc_md:
Textarea for multi-line text. Works with v-model. Use rows and placeholder to guide input.

```vue
<Textarea v-model="notes" rows="4" />
```

name: checkbox
usage_doc_md:
Checkbox for boolean or multi-select lists. Use with v-model:checked for state. Combine with Label for accessible text.

```vue
<Checkbox v-model:checked="marketing" />
```

name: switch
usage_doc_md:
Switch toggles a setting on/off. Bind with v-model:checked. Include a Label to explain the setting.

```vue
<Switch v-model:checked="enabled" />
```

name: select
usage_doc_md:
Select renders an accessible dropdown. Use SelectTrigger/SelectContent with items. Bind selected value via v-model.

```vue
<Select v-model="role"><SelectItem value="admin">Admin</SelectItem></Select>
```
snippet_text:
<template>
  <Select v-model="role">
    <SelectTrigger class="w-[220px]">
      <SelectValue placeholder="Choose a role" />
    </SelectTrigger>
    <SelectContent>
      <SelectItem value="viewer">Viewer</SelectItem>
      <SelectItem value="editor">Editor</SelectItem>
      <SelectItem value="admin">Admin</SelectItem>
    </SelectContent>
  </Select>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent, SelectItem } from '@/components/ui/select'

const role = ref('viewer')
</script>

name: tabs
usage_doc_md:
Tabs switch between panels. Use TabsList for triggers and TabsContent for panels. Control via default-value or v-model.


</script>

name: calendar
usage_doc_md:
Calendar renders a date grid. Often used inside Popover for date picking. Provide selected date and onSelect handler.

```vue
<Calendar v-model="date" />
```
snippet_text:
<template>
  <Popover>
    <PopoverTrigger as-child>
      <Button variant="outline" class="w-[240px] justify-start">{{ label }}</Button>
    </PopoverTrigger>
    <PopoverContent class="w-auto p-0">
      <Calendar v-model="date" />
    </PopoverContent>
  </Popover>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Calendar } from '@/components/ui/calendar'
import { Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent } from '@/components/ui/popover'

const date = ref<Date | null>(null)
const label = computed(() => date.value ? date.value.toDateString() : 'Pick a date')
</script>
